answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 149025 Country: India Title: Can I keep my son's name as Hasanain? Question: Can I keep my son's name as Hasanain? Answer ID: 149025 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 698/585/H=6/1438) It is better to keep any of the names: Hasan or Hussain or Nisarul Hasnain. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
